## v1.39.0

Fixes the order of the user's line on spoken turns. The user line now carries the `speechId` of the reply it prompted. Nothing breaks: the field was `null` before.

### Added

- `TranscriptLog` (from `@kaltura/intelligent-agents/experience`) keeps the conversation in speaking order. Feed it every `transcript` event and it puts each `user` line before its reply. (#489)

### Fixed

- On a spoken turn the server sends the first reply sentence before the user's words, so `transcript` events arrived reply first. The `user` transcript now has the `speechId` of its reply, so an app can pair them. A line with no reply to pair with keeps `speechId: null`. (#489)

### Docs and skill

- The end-to-end turn page explains the arrival order and shows `TranscriptLog`. The events catalog and `START-THE-CONVERSATION.md` match. (#489)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.38.0...v1.39.0
